nodes.rationale: Hibernation allows idle Objects to sleep without socket disconnection and reduces compute use. Fixed runtime heartbeats and durable deadlines must preserve expiry without always-running timers.

nodes.label: Commit-before-broadcast and command deduplication
nodes.description: Actor/game-scoped command ID durably stores accepted mutation, revision and result before acknowledgement/push. Call, all board effects and qualification form one logical change. Query/retry original ID after unknown outcome; broadcast failure never rolls back a commit.
nodes.rationale: Avoid duplicate random draws and inconsistent call-versus-board state under retries, crash and acknowledgement loss.

nodes.label: Recurring Free-plan hosting budget
nodes.description: No trials, paid upgrade or proven zero-cost production capacity. Documented planning guardrails: Worker 100000 requests/day, 10 ms CPU/HTTP request, 128 MB/isolate; DO 100000 request-units/day, 13000 GB-seconds/day; SQLite 5 million rows read/day, 100000 written/day, 5 GB total. Direct assets free/unlimited. Recheck before release.
nodes.rationale: Worker and DO budgets are distinct and one operation may consume both; retained History, admission, board generation, fan-out and reconnect load all require headroom.

nodes.label: Single-use access-link enrollment
nodes.description: CLI or authorized admin durably provisions verifier before privately returning a one-day single-use HTTPS link. Atomic consume plus restricted one-day session; mandatory password setup rotates credential while preserving original deadline. Later login uses chosen password.
nodes.rationale: Replaces only the generated initial password, not later password authentication; lost redemption response cannot make a consumed token reusable.

nodes.label: Per-game capacity limits
nodes.description: Independent player default/hard ceiling 20, integer range 2-20; spectator default/hard ceiling 50, range 0-50. Backend counts memberships not sockets; New-only designated-host/admin edits. Zero spectators disables admission, not start.
nodes.rationale: Product admission ceilings are separate from Cloudflare quotas and cannot establish safe measured load.

nodes.label: Snapshot-first reconnection
nodes.description: Gap-free snapshot/subscription ordering, full authorized snapshot on every reconnect, base/result view revisions, foreground/periodic repair and obsolete-socket discard. Connecting/Synchronizing/Live/Reconnecting with jittered backoff capped at 30 seconds. One live connection per participant session.
nodes.rationale: Fresh durable snapshots repair missed broadcasts and matches without a replay archive, client mark replay or board regeneration; heartbeat success proves neither authorization nor freshness.

nodes.label: Fixed one-day role-bound sessions
nodes.description: Opaque backend-issued Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite cookies with fixed one-day absolute expiry, distinct enrollment/account/player/spectator bindings and revocation. No sliding renewal, localStorage tokens or access extension from retained seats; enforce expiry on live/hibernating sockets.
nodes.rationale: Stable game/member identity plus server-held bindings prevent code/alias reuse or client flags from conferring authority.

nodes.label: Brews-answer player recovery
nodes.description: Optional private salted nonreversible verifier; only code plus remembered current alias plus matching enrolled answer recovers an existing Awaiting Players/In Progress membership. Atomically replace prior tokens/sockets with a fresh one-day session. No board generation, role/seat change, alias lookup or host/admin fallback. Valid-session owners may set/replace/delete answer; delete on spectator switch/terminal.
nodes.rationale: Convenience proof is weak and guessable, not strong identity or host-password recovery. Skipping is allowed but loses lost-session recovery; hashes/rate limits do not make predictable answers strong.

nodes.label: Host-mediated single-winner award
nodes.description: Real-life Bingo/alias judged by host; designated host or enrolled admin submits exactly one qualified same-game member. Backend acceptance atomically freezes winner/result as Resolved. Offline/departed qualifying players remain eligible. Pool exhaustion/qualification alone never resolve.
nodes.rationale: Separate qualification from human first-caller judgment and final award; no automatic tie-break, microphone detection, second winner or outcome rewrite.

nodes.label: Pattern-specific Rust traits
nodes.description: Each distinct winning pattern has its own Rust trait boundary in provider-independent shared/domain. Single Line is the only specified pattern; row/column/diagonal are orientations, not separate modes.
nodes.rationale: Keep rule evaluation independent of networking, host permissions, human Bingo timing and winner selection; any LLD orchestration must not replace separate pattern traits with only a generic trait.

nodes.label: Automatic call matching
nodes.description: Authorized random/manual call validates In Progress, pool membership and nonduplication. Match every board, including offline/departed players; evaluate Single Line and durably commit call/boards/flags/revision/result before WSS. Rejections and accepted retries have no duplicate effects.
nodes.rationale: Backend accepted state, not clicks, socket delivery or player acknowledgements, determines matches and qualification.

nodes.label: Game lifecycle
nodes.description: Exactly New, Awaiting Players, In Progress, Resolved and Cancelled; no sixth closed state. Winner path progresses to Resolved; cancellation/no-winner ending goes to Cancelled. Configuration freezes in Awaiting Players.
nodes.rationale: Exit changes access/navigation, not terminal gameplay; obsolete four-state/no-winner-Resolved wording is superseded.

nodes.label: Terminal immutability and independent Exit
nodes.description: Resolved/Cancelled forbid calls, board generation/reassignment, matching, rule/outcome edits, reopening and new admission. Exit only updates access/navigation; no second Close and no wait for viewers. After exit hosts use History, not game re-entry. Player final restoration ends at Exit/original expiry; spectator cleanup is stricter.
nodes.rationale: Durable terminal outcome releases global reservation independently from final viewers; scheduled expiry is deletion, not a mutable outcome.

nodes.label: Read-only final History
nodes.description: Started games ending Resolved or Cancelled retain ordered called strings, participating aliases, optional winning alias and one self-contained final board snapshot per player, including free cells/matches. All enrolled hosts/admins may read; no replay timeline, credentials, recovery authority or initial-release export.
nodes.rationale: Final snapshots must stand alone rather than depend on live membership/session records; pre-start cancellations have no History.

nodes.label: Three-month History expiry
nodes.description: Fixed three calendar months from first durable started-game terminal transition; no silent 90-day substitution or renewal on reads/exits/retries. Deny at expiry and durably schedule/retry deletion without visits across record/indexes/caches/backups/restores. No separate one-week player-data TTL.
nodes.rationale: Retention is distinct from access/session validity; copies and restore operations must not extend or resurrect expired History.

nodes.label: Connected-player start gate
nodes.description: Explicit designated-host/admin start requires fixed valid rules, continuing global-slot ownership, feasible position-distinct boards and at least two distinct currently connected players with valid sessions. All retained roster members, including disconnected players, receive boards. Spectators/duplicate sockets never count.
nodes.rationale: Separates connection eligibility from retained roster membership; rejects infeasible starts rather than accepting duplicate boards or unlimited regeneration.

nodes.label: Random distinct board generation
nodes.description: Generate/assign immediately after accepted start, never join/recovery. Sample non-free cells from valid string pool without within-board repeats or row/column restrictions; regenerate cell-for-cell duplicates across players. Same values in different positions are distinct. Check feasibility before Start; assignments/flags persist before first call.
nodes.rationale: Position-sensitive uniqueness avoids identical player layouts without requiring globally disjoint values; reject infeasible settings instead of relying on unbounded retries.

nodes.label: Configurable free cells
nodes.description: Checkbox defaults true; one-based default cell (ceil(height/2), ceil(width/2)) for every supported size. Host may disable or choose up to all cells before rules freeze. Free cells have no pool values, satisfy matching at assignment and may immediately qualify. All-free fails minimum-two-player distinct-board feasibility.
nodes.rationale: Qualification is not an award; unrestricted free-cell count is preserved while distinct-board feasibility independently constrains Start.

nodes.label: Pre-start cancellation and idle cleanup
nodes.description: Confirmed manual New/Awaiting Players cancellation or 24 hours without qualifying designated-host activity commits Cancelled, then deletes game/participant data and safely releases slot, with no History or board generation. Notices/independent exits do not gate cleanup.
nodes.rationale: Only authenticated host open/resume/accepted actions reset idle deadline, not background traffic or other users; timer never ends In Progress.

nodes.label: Membership and connection retention
nodes.description: Pre-start player disconnect keeps alias/seat until start/cancel; explicit Leave releases them. In Progress Leave/disconnect retains board and award eligibility, permits valid-session/answer return. Spectator disconnect grants five-minute seat grace, intentional Leave releases immediately. One connection per participant session; pre-start role switching atomically observes target capacity.
nodes.rationale: Connection/socket count, membership retention, session expiry and intentional terminal Exit are separate; none silently grants renewed credentials.

nodes.label: Spectator terminal and seat cleanup
nodes.description: At explicit seat release, grace expiry or terminal end delete spectator identity/session data. Deliver terminal result to connected spectators then leave only local view until Exit; no terminal reconnect/refresh fetch even before Exit.
nodes.rationale: Supersedes earlier generic pre-exit spectator final-view restoration; failed delivery must not retain spectator data indefinitely.

nodes.label: Game code
nodes.description: Exactly eight random uppercase ASCII A-Z/0-9 characters, case-insensitive lookup with outer ASCII-space trim and no internal spaces. Issued in Awaiting Players, stable until terminal; unknown codes never create games. Collision checks cover live games and unexpired History; later reuse cannot transfer old credentials.
nodes.rationale: Code discovers stable game identity; it is not host/admin access or proof of existing-player ownership.

nodes.label: Confirmed designated-host transfer
nodes.description: Designated host or admin selects another fully enrolled host/admin and confirms; backend commits immediately with no recipient acceptance. Ownership changes, game data/reservations do not. Outgoing host retains read-only board access; admin overrides persist.
nodes.rationale: Viewing, disconnection or an admin action alone never transfers ownership; recheck current committed authority when concurrent actions execute.

nodes.label: Privileged account management
nodes.description: CLI/enrolled admins provision and manage enrollment/reset links. Reset revokes target sessions/sockets and blocks old login until setup; pending reissue invalidates old links/restricted sessions without duplicating account. Disable/delete blocked while target hosts nonterminal game.
nodes.rationale: Admin app management supersedes earlier developer-exclusive wording without distributing cloud credentials or granting ordinary hosts provisioning rights.

nodes.label: Player terminal credential cleanup
nodes.description: Delete answer verifiers at terminal; started-game players keep only minimal existing-session/exit authorization until Exit or original one-day expiry. No new terminal recovery. Pre-start cancellation deletes participant data; History retains final aliases/boards separately.
nodes.rationale: Operational credentials must not become History content or extend final-view access.

nodes.label: Single nonterminal-game reservation
nodes.description: At most one New/Awaiting Players/In Progress game application-wide. Claim at New creation, retain at start, commit terminal state before retry-safe owner-specific release. Never release on disconnection/exit or let stale retries release a newer owner.
nodes.rationale: HLD-077 supersedes the former separate unstarted and In-Progress slots; Directory/Game coordination is not a cross-Object transaction.

nodes.label: Privileged account enable
nodes.description: Required API/app and CLI enable functionality: another enrolled admin or developer CLI only, never self-enable. Derive disabled status exclusively from populated disabled_at; disable sets timestamp, enable clears it while retaining Active/PendingEnrollment/ResetRequired lifecycle. No duplicate boolean or previous-status copy.
nodes.rationale: Re-enable restores prior lifecycle, not revoked credentials: Active permits fresh password login; pending/reset still need fresh links/setup. Never role-upgrade or recreate deleted account.

nodes.label: Deferred detailed design
nodes.description: Account-store placement, schemas, transaction ownership, cross-Object coordination, protocol fields, crate versions, hash/password policy, cleanup, UI/accessibility/announcements and quality/browser matrices remain unselected. Native packaging is later work.

nodes.label: Quota exhaustion and unavailable operation
nodes.description: Affected free-tier operations may fail on allowance exhaustion. Surface unavailable/failed writes, disable gameplay and never acknowledge an uncommitted mutation or silently upgrade to paid service.
nodes.rationale: Free-hosting selection is a budget boundary, not an availability guarantee or a measured attendance guarantee.

nodes.label: Awaiting Players
nodes.description: After valid configuration/code publication, rules and limits are fixed. Player/spectator admission and saved lobby resume; no boards. Cannot return to New/edit rules. Explicit eligible Start or cancellation only.

nodes.label: Cancelled
nodes.description: All final no-winner outcomes: New/Awaiting Players cancellation or confirmed manual ending in In Progress. Immutable. Pre-start data deleted without History; started-game final History retained.

nodes.label: Rust Worker
nodes.description: Backend entrypoint performs access checks and routing: discovery/global coordination to Directory, gameplay to the owning Game Durable Object. Managed Wasm server components, not a native VM/container process.

nodes.label: Backend security and privacy controls
nodes.description: Backend validation/authorization on commands, upgrades and delivery; Origin/CSRF protection, safe alias rendering, parameterized storage, verifier-only secrets, log redaction, bounded abuse controls and private-cache clearing. Password policy, algorithms and thresholds deferred.
nodes.rationale: HttpOnly is not CSRF protection; random codes are not authentication, and predictable Brews answers remain weak proof despite hashing/rate limits.

nodes.label: New

nodes.label: Developer-only CLI
nodes.description: Developer operational provisioning and account-management path using privileged Cloudflare environment credentials. First-admin bootstrap must use CLI; language, commands and access mechanism remain unselected.
nodes.rationale: Cloud credentials remain in controlled developer/server environments, never browser builds; admins use backend-authorized app APIs, not the credential-bearing CLI.

nodes.label: SQLite-backed Durable Object storage
nodes.description: Each owning Object has strongly consistent transactional storage. Boards and accepted changes persist independently of process/socket lifetime; no cross-Object transaction is assumed.

nodes.label: Admin-only Users view
nodes.description: Enrolled admins list provisioned host/admin accounts; backend denies others, not just hidden navigation. Anonymous memberships not listed; no secrets. Columns, pagination and layouts remain LLD/UI.

nodes.label: HTTPS
nodes.description: Enrollment, login/setup, admission, recovery, commands, command-result lookup and History use HTTPS; recovery answers only in protected bodies, never URLs or socket messages.

nodes.label: Square board and string-pool configuration
nodes.description: Equal integer sides 2-10 inclusive, default 5×5; values are strings, initially numeric 1 through host-defined upper bound default 75. Validate sufficient distinct pool for non-free cells before Awaiting Players. Configuration frozen thereafter.

nodes.label: Planning approval boundary

nodes.rationale: Preserve staged review and prevent approved architectural direction from being mistaken for permission to scaffold, provision or deploy.

Latency/capacity targets and procedures still TBD.
nodes.rationale: Documented HLD decisions and planned tests do not establish working software, proven free-tier capacity or release readiness.

nodes.label: Salted Argon2 account-password hashing

nodes.rationale: Salt and hash must be atomically co-located so reset/rehash cannot leave mismatched pairs; slow hashing must not undo concurrent revocation.

nodes.label: Protected credential input transport
nodes.description: Passwords, recovery answers and bearer redemption proof belong in protected HTTPS bodies, never query strings or WSS. Session bearer issuance/rotation uses protected HttpOnly cookies, never JSON bodies.
nodes.rationale: Prevent credential disclosure in URLs, socket protocols, examples, logs and ordinary response payloads.

nodes.label: Username normalization rules
nodes.description: Trim outer ASCII whitespace 0x09-0x0D/0x20; validate 10-50 decoded ASCII chars with no internal whitespace. Preserve casing; temporary ASCII-lowercase for uniqueness/login, no stored normalized key; other controls including NUL/DEL preserved. SQL/transport/UI/error details TBD.
nodes.rationale: Apply identical creation/login identity rules without storing redundant normalized identity or silently changing permitted input.
